replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
Okay, with my first review for tournament gameplay; let me sort it out. This will mostly be improvements instead of compliments, but all in all this is a nice map.

1. The TNT chests are not too definitive of their contents. In the same area and line, there are supply chests. I feel that there isn't really anything defining the difference and so would make things confusing. I would use item frames or carpet or something to represent that the chests differ from those by it, or maybe move them to another location.

2. The chests are too open to being destroyed. While in a tournament supplies are certainly a big part of the map, this map has too vulnerable chests to be blown to smithereens. One whiskey cannon made in 16 seconds could not be enough time to water the ship and gear up to play, thus exploding all the chests and causing the game to be unfair running out of supplies within just a span of those 16 seconds. The chests should have a relocation or move to a spot where it's not so close to spawn to just jump back in, and a location where it won't get completely killed.

3. The water isn't a good idea. By crafting a boat and going to their side (which, in fact inside the vehicle), is too easy to NOT get shot. The 1 block water also, for this, is just frustrating and should be removed fixing both issues. Also due to the ship's angle, it will be hard to get up from a recovery by landing in it, so it's certainly an almost surefire way to get killed. There isn't much point in the water unless you want your matches to be rushed.

4. Your map seems to not have been built on top of just Y:0. This is an issue that will cause underbridging and issues with the water you have due to the block 36. It is encouraged to move to Y:0 so your map is less laggy, solves underbridging issues, and stops 36 issues.

5. Your map, with it's size, needs bedrock. It'll just turn into void within about 2 minutes if a team just cannons it a couple times, and without it it doesn't have good backing. I recommend layering the ship more and expanding it by maybe 30 blocks out (the map in it's current state is too small and vulnerable to enemy fire) and adding the bedrock so it doesn't make it impossible to play and allows the team to have more room. Going hand-in-hand with this, the bottom is way too cramped (where the chests and iron is) and you shouldn't have it so low that you can just sprint jump going super fast, as well as the space offering no PvP room.

Compared to some other TE maps as well, it's very tiny.

6. A problem with your chests; since you rotated and didn't flip, the contents are all scattered and different from the other team's side. This is absolutely required to be fixed as it's unfair to the team that gets the messed up chest different from the other side, and so it takes longer to browse. 

7. Technical issue with your map; monuments can only be obsidian, not lapis. Having one above spawn also may be too much of an issue due to spawnkilling and if the other team defends it, it'll be too hard to get to. 4 blocks also may be too much; 2 objectives are recommended. 

I want to say now that the spawn dip is kind of annoying to climb out of and you glitch out with the stairs, so I'd prefer you'd make it flat. You also have it too easy for a cannon to shoot in it, because if it lands above it'll pierce right through and kill everyone spawned there in 1 hit. It'll just be who can dodge the TNT without dying.
